variants.headline: Strike collapses
variants.body: The strike by the union {name} has collapsed. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: Labour action loses its course
variants.body: The union {name} has seen its strike collapse. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: A strike ends in collapse
variants.body: The strike by {name} has ended in collapse. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.
